propositions: transport.py grew to 799 LOC (at module-size cap limit of 800), forcing repeated rescue splits that did not address root cause of continued growth
Previous reactive splits (retry.py, transitions.py) lacked a determining principle, so new capabilities defaulted to transport.py, triggering re-bloat
Capability protocols already defined in _backend.py (_TicketTransport, _SupportsLinks, _SupportsComments, _SupportsAbsenceProbe) form clean, disjoint seams that should organize the module structure

Reorganization into capability-aligned mixins (_base, _issues, _hierarchy, _links, _people) with thin composition root keeps JiraDataCenterTransport as a single class satisfying protocols while ensuring all modules stay 100–500 LOC
Merger of _comments.py and _properties.py (each fell below 100-LOC floor) with _links.py and _people.py respectively; _resolve_epic_link_field_id remains single-defined in _hierarchy.py
Test suite (2244 unit tests) passes unedited after relocation; JiraDataCenterTransport protocol conformance, facade exports, and shape contract unchanged
